raw.question: Use workspace key only as an idempotency hint for POST /v1/workspaces; always mint a fresh key for genuinely new workspaces
raw.chosen: Use workspace key only as an idempotency hint for POST /v1/workspaces; always mint a fresh key for genuinely new workspaces
raw.reasoning: The local daemon already behaves this way, and reusing the caller's existing workspace key for a different workspace name would collide with the unique api_key_hash constraint and break workspace creation semantics.

retrospective.summary: Fixed hosted workspace idempotency plumbing, added SDK support for authenticated idempotent workspace bootstrap calls, updated docs/spec, and validated with focused plus full test runs
